endpoints.name: payments_list_integration_providers
endpoints.description: List White-label Integration Providers The "List White-label Integration Providers" API allows to retrieve a paginated list of integration providers. Customize your results by filtering whitelabel integration providers(which are built directly on top of Authorize.net or NMI) based on name or paginate through the list using the provided query parameters. This endpoint provides a straightforward way to explore and retrieve integration p… [GET /payments/integrations/provider/whitelabel] Token: location. Scopes: payments/integration.readonly.

altId.description: location Id / company Id based on altType

endpoints.name: payments_create_integration_provider
endpoints.description: Create White-label Integration Provider The "Create White-label Integration Provider" API allows adding a new payment provider integration to the system which is built on top of Authorize.net or NMI. Use this endpoint to create a integration provider with the specified details. Ensure that the required information is provided in the request payload. This endpoint can be only invoked using marketplace-app token [POST /payments/integrations/provider/whitelabel] Token: location. Scopes: payments/integration.write.

altId.description: location Id / company Id based on altType

uniqueName.description: A unique name given to the integration provider, uniqueName must start and end with a character. Only lowercase characters and hyphens (-) are supported

title.description: The title or name of the integration provider.

provider.description: The type of payment provider associated with the integration provider.

description.description: A brief description providing additional information about the integration provider.

imageUrl.description: The URL to an image representing the integration provider. The imageUrl should start with "https://" and ensure that this URL is publicly accessible.

endpoints.name: payments_list_orders
endpoints.description: List Orders The "List Orders" API allows to retrieve a paginated list of orders. Customize your results by filtering orders based on name, alt type, order status, payment mode, date range, type of source, contact, funnel products or paginate through the list using the provided query parameters. This endpoint provides a straightforward way to explore and retrieve order information. [GET /payments/orders] Token: location. Scopes: payments/orders.readonly.

locationId.description: LocationId is the id of the sub-account.

altId.description: AltId is the unique identifier e.g: location id.

search.description: The name of the order for searching.

contactId.description: Contact id for filtering of orders.

funnelProductIds.description: Funnel product ids separated by comma.

endpoints.name: payments_get_order_by_id
endpoints.description: Get Order by ID The "Get Order by ID" API allows to retrieve information for a specific order using its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to fetch details for a single order based on the provided order ID. [GET /payments/orders/{orderId}] Token: location. Scopes: payments/orders.readonly.

orderId.description: ID of the order that needs to be returned

locationId.description: LocationId is the id of the sub-account.

altId.description: AltId is the unique identifier e.g: location id.

endpoints.name: payments_record_order_payment
endpoints.description: Record Order Payment The "Record Order Payment" API allows to record a payment for an order. Use this endpoint to record payment for an order and update the order status to "Paid". [POST /payments/orders/{orderId}/record-payment] Token: location. Scopes: payments/orders.collectPayment.

altId.description: location Id / company Id based on altType

card.description: Details of Card if used for payment

cheque.description: Details of the Cheque if used for payment

notes.description: Any note to be recorded with the transaction

amount.description: Amount to be paid against the invoice.

meta.description: Meta data to be recorded with the transaction

isPartialPayment.description: Indicates if the order is intended to be a partial payment.

endpoints.name: payments_list_coupons
endpoints.description: List Coupons The "List Coupons" API allows you to retrieve a list of all coupons available in your location. Use this endpoint to view all promotional offers and special discounts for your customers. [GET /payments/coupon/list] Token: location. Scopes: payments/coupons.readonly.

search.description: Search term to filter coupons by name or code

endpoints.name: payments_get_coupon
endpoints.description: Fetch Coupon The "Get Coupon Details" API enables you to retrieve comprehensive information about a specific coupon using either its unique identifier or promotional code. Use this endpoint to view coupon parameters, usage statistics, validity periods, and other promotional details. [GET /payments/coupon] Token: location. Scopes: payments/coupons.readonly.

endpoints.name: payments_create_coupon
endpoints.description: Create Coupon The "Create Coupon" API allows you to create a new promotional coupon with customizable parameters such as discount amount, validity period, usage limits, and applicable products. Use this endpoint to set up promotional offers and special discounts for your customers. [POST /payments/coupon] Token: location. Scopes: payments/coupons.write.

usageLimit.description: Max number of times coupon can be used

applyToFuturePayments.description: Is Coupon applicable on upcoming subscription transactions (default: true)

duration.description: Duration the coupon to be applied in a subscription

applyToFuturePaymentsConfig.description: If coupon is applicable on upcoming subscription transactions, how many months should it be applicable for a subscription (default: {"type":"forever"})

limitPerCustomer.description: Limits whether a coupon can be redeemed only once per customer. (default: false)

endpoints.name: payments_update_coupon
endpoints.description: Update Coupon The "Update Coupon" API enables you to modify existing coupon details such as discount values, validity periods, usage limits, and other promotional parameters. Use this endpoint to adjust or extend promotional offers for your customers. [PUT /payments/coupon] Token: location. Scopes: payments/coupons.write.

usageLimit.description: Max number of times coupon can be used

applyToFuturePayments.description: Is Coupon applicable on upcoming subscription transactions (default: true)

duration.description: Duration the coupon to be applied in a subscription

applyToFuturePaymentsConfig.description: If coupon is applicable on upcoming subscription transactions, how many months should it be applicable for a subscription (default: {"type":"forever"})

limitPerCustomer.description: Limits whether a coupon can be redeemed only once per customer. (default: false)

endpoints.name: payments_delete_coupon
endpoints.description: Delete Coupon The "Delete Coupon" API allows you to permanently remove a coupon from your system using its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to discontinue promotional offers or clean up unused coupons. Note that this action cannot be undone. [DELETE /payments/coupon] Token: location. Scopes: payments/coupons.write.
